notes: Part numbers are from the Canadian edition of the parts book (October 2024), standard RE250T column; the same book's RE250T Alternate column lists magnesium and aluminium outlet anodes instead of the hex-head aluminium one, so check which anode is fitted. The US spec sheet rates the tank at 50 U.S. gal where the Canadian sheet says 47.

gaps: Heating element: only the kit number is claimed; the book's element charts (page 10) list copper and Incoloy 4500 W elements but don't say which one the kit is.
Lower thermostat: the column lists two options (415-50691-00 with high limit, 415-51046-00 with protector); the first is claimed and the second named in its spec.
The spec sheet table gives an element wattage range of 4000 to 6000 W for RE250T6; only the parts book's 4500 W element is claimed.
The book points to page 12 for anode lengths, but that page is a contact page, so no anode length is claimed.
Capacity: the US sheet says 50 U.S. gal (42 imp.), the Canadian sheet C1201 says 47 U.S. gal (39 imp., 178 L); the US figure is used for the tank.
data/parts has no aluminium anode type, so the anode is filed under rod_shaft.
method: Bradford White Canada Residential Electric Replacement parts book #238-54105-00F (effective October 2024), PDF copy on res.cloudinary (wholesale-plumbing): page 5 (RE250T column, rendered and read) and page 10 (element charts, not claimed).

Bradford White upright electric spec sheet 1201 (copy on docs.bradfordwhite.com, footer 1201-0926): page 1 (features) and page 2 (RE250T6 row). The Canadian sheet C1201 page 2 gives the 47 U.S. gal rating.
The newer parts book revision 238-54105-00G (June 2025, docs.bradfordwhite.com) was read: the claimed rows carry the same part numbers.
supplyhouse.com returned HTTP 403 to the researcher and was not used.

comps.spec: Heating element, 240 V 4500 W, with gasket: Bradford White 415-48642-00 (listed as qty 2 for this column)
Upper thermostat with high limit (59T66) and protector: Bradford White 415-51046-00
Lower thermostat with high limit (59T66): Bradford White 415-50691-00 (this column also lists 415-51046-00 for a lower thermostat with protector)
Hex-head sacrificial anode, aluminium: Bradford White 415-55485-00 (may need cutting to length)
Temperature and pressure relief valve: Bradford White 415-40594-02
Tank rated 50 U.S. gal (42 imp. gal) on the US spec sheet, with a DOE rated storage volume of 45 U.S. gal
Non-CFC foam insulation covering the tank
